title: Standardized Auto-Guess, Local KB Clarifications, Mobile Scroll & Powiatdle Beta
body:
- Standardized direct-name auto-guess and spoiler-free question clarifications across Continental, Powiatdle, US Statedle, and Wojewodztwodle.
- Improved Powiatdle local KB answering (parent voivodeship coastal checks, list-valued plate prefix/suffix checks, English/unaccented Polish region and city aliases, urban/rural gmina counts) and fixed false auto-wins on substring queries.
- Improved mobile scrolling smoothness and added a Beta / In Development badge to Powiatdle.
